productOverview.headline: Enterprise-Grade Precision for Demanding Surveys
productOverview.description: The DJI Matrice 350 RTK pairs a built-in RTK/PPK GNSS module with interchangeable LiDAR and photogrammetry payloads, delivering survey-grade accuracy across dense vegetation, powerline corridors, and large-scale engineering sites.

keyFeatures.headline: Key Features
keyFeatures.description: Everything that makes the M350 RTK the benchmark heavy-lift survey platform.

items.title: Built-in RTK/PPK GNSS
items.description: Supports Network RTK (CORS), D-RTK 2 Base Station, and PPK workflows for redundancy.

items.title: DJI Zenmuse L2 LiDAR
items.description: 240,000 pts/sec laser return rate with 450 m range and ≤4 cm vertical accuracy, ideal for dense vegetation and terrain penetration.

items.title: DJI Zenmuse P1 Photogrammetry
items.description: 45 MP full-frame global shutter camera delivering 1.5-3 cm GSD at 100 m altitude.

items.title: Long Endurance
items.description: Up to 55 minutes flight time, 30-45 minutes typical survey endurance with payload.

positioningAndAccuracy.headline: Positioning & Accuracy
positioningAndAccuracy.description: Survey-grade GNSS positioning built into the airframe.

flightPerformance.headline: Flight Performance
flightPerformance.description: Built for extended, stable survey missions.
list: Typical survey endurance: 30-45 minutes (with LiDAR/camera payload)
Wind resistance: 12 m/s (critical for stable mapping)

payloadOptions.headline: Payload Options (Survey-Focused)
payloadOptions.description: Interchangeable payloads for LiDAR mapping and photogrammetry.

items.label: DJI Zenmuse L2 (LiDAR Mapping)
items.description: Laser return rate 240,000 pts/sec, 450 m range, vertical accuracy ≤4 cm, integrated RGB camera for colorized point clouds. Ideal for dense vegetation mapping, powerline corridors, and terrain penetration.

items.label: DJI Zenmuse P1 (Photogrammetry)
items.description: 45 MP full-frame sensor with global shutter (no rolling distortion). GSD ~1.5-3 cm at 100 m altitude. Accuracy: 3-5 cm absolute (with GCPs), sub-centimeter relative.

specs.headline: Technical Specifications
specs.description: Complete technical details for the DJI Matrice 350 RTK.

surveyApplications.headline: Survey Applications
surveyApplications.description: Where the M350 RTK excels in the field.
list: Engineering corridor mapping (roads, pipelines, transmission lines)
Eliminates heavy dependence on ground control points (GCPs)
Integrates directly into Civil 3D, ArcGIS, Pix4D, Metashape workflows
